title: Endpoints Reference
lede: The gateway's surface is small. Here are the routes you'll use.
body:
At a glance
  • Discover engines.
  • Synthesize and preview.
  • Fetch job status and audio.

Routes

Method & pathPurpose
GET /api/v1/tts/enginesList installed engines.
GET /api/v1/tts/engines/{id}Details for one engine.
POST /api/v1/tts/synthesizeSynthesize text (inline or queued).
POST /api/v1/tts/previewQuick preview synthesis.
GET /api/v1/tts/jobs/{id}Poll a queued job's status.
GET /api/v1/tts/jobs/{id}/audioDownload a finished job's audio.

See Inline vs Queued + Polling for how short and long text differ, and Examples for copy-paste calls.
